Thy son sustain'd that heavy load
Of base reproach and sore disgrace,
And shame defil'd his sacred face.
Watts made this hymn from Psalm 69:7–24, "in the language of the New Testament": a paraphrase, not a translation. The line that comes closest to it is marked.
